description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.20.0: opt-in fixed-condition lesson comparisons, execution receipts, conflict-aware single-proposal undo, scoped operation claims with uncertainty holds, and stage-separated Jev/Jarvis connector diagnostics. Existing source-bound compact constraints, recall, provenance, cooperative partial edits and warning-first lint remain. No default model/network calls or automatic promotion/rollback. Receipts and Jev judgments are data, not authority or exactly-once guarantees. Windows lock contention may fail closed. Existing vault permissions, budgets and Jarvis API-auth requirements remain under host control.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
